text:
Which statement describes two atoms of different isotopes of an element?
A
two atoms with the same nucleon number but different proton number
B
two atoms with a different nucleon number but the same proton number
C
two atoms with the same nucleon number and the same proton number
D
two atoms with a different nucleon number and different proton number

options.label: A
options.text: two atoms with the same nucleon number but different proton number

options.label: B
options.text: two atoms with a different nucleon number but the same proton number

options.label: C
options.text: two atoms with the same nucleon number and the same proton number

options.label: D
options.text: two atoms with a different nucleon number and different proton number
